moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 3
Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

moves.name: Psychic Terrain
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Psychic-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot be hit by moves with priority greater than 0, unless the target is an ally. Camouflage transforms the user into a Psychic type, Nature Power becomes Psychic, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Psychic Terrain.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.description:
Psychic (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description:
Psychic (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: -7
For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description:
Fairy (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description:
Water (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Damp Rock. Fails if the current weather is Rain.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Light Clay
items.description: Holder's use of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, or Reflect lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

items.name: Colbur Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Dark-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Scope Lens
items.description: Holder's critical hit ratio is raised by 1 stage.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Kasib Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Ghost-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Bright Powder
items.description: The accuracy of attacks against the holder is 0.9x.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.description: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves ignore substitutes and the opposing side's Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, Mist, and Aurora Veil.
